content:
Apple today announced it will hold a special event next Tuesday (October 13) themed "Welcome Home."

Apple will unveil a new Home lineup on October 13, teased by Greg Joswiak

Apple will launch new products next Tuesday (October 13), with Apple's Senior Vice President of Worldwide Marketing Greg Joswiak revealing the news in a teaser video. Below is the video posted by Joswiak.

Apple is expected to unveil several new Home products at the event, including:

We may also see the home accessory product leaked earlier, reportedly co-developed by Apple and LG, make its debut next week.

Alongside Joswiak's announcement of the date, Apple has also sent invitations to the media for an "Apple Experience" special event to be held at 9 AM Eastern Time in Tribeca, New York.

Below is the invitation shared by Marques Brownlee:

Featured comment posted by JP

Three products. I'm guessing it's  Car, in Space Gray, White, and another slightly different White.

Earlier this year, when Apple launched the MacBook Neo, it also held a similar "Apple Experience" event for the media. At the time, new products were released over consecutive days in the form of press releases before the official unveiling.

However, the market generally expects that all of Apple's new Home products will debut on the same day.

Whether Apple will simultaneously release the full product introduction video online at 9 AM Eastern Time remains unconfirmed. We will continue to update you with the latest news.

Which new products are you most looking forward to Apple launching on October 13? Let us know in the comments.
